errors.dueChanged: What is left on this contract changed (a payment was just taken). The figures were reloaded: check them and try again.
errors.notOpen: This contract is no longer open.
errors.failed: The change could not be saved.

settle.title: Settle contract {number} early
settle.description: The customer pays everything left today and the contract closes. A manager may waive part of the profit of the installments not yet due; it is a decision made now, never promised in advance.
settle.quoteFailed: The payoff could not be loaded.
settle.futureProfit: Profit of installments not yet due
settle.suggestion: The shop's policy suggests waiving {amount}. This is a suggestion only: you decide.

errors.waiverTooHigh: The waiver can be at most {max}.

reschedule.title: Reschedule contract {number}
reschedule.description: What is left is spread over new installments. The total never grows: the new installments add up to exactly what is left. The old schedule stays on the contract.
reschedule.previewFailed: The new schedule could not be worked out.
reschedule.totalSame: The new installments add up to {amount}, exactly what is left.
reschedule.caption: The new schedule

violations.frequency_not_allowed: The shop's policy doesn't allow this frequency.
violations.first_due_date_out_of_range: The first installment must fall between tomorrow and 60 days from today.
violations.rounding: Too many installments for what is left: choose fewer.

errors.invalid: The new schedule doesn't meet the rules: check the preview.

writeOff.title: Write off contract {number}
writeOff.description: What is left is marked as lost and the contract closes. It shows in the reports.

errors.ownerOnly: Only the owner can write off a contract.

list.title: Contract changes
list.description: Early settlements, reschedules and write-offs, newest first.
list.loadFailed: The changes could not be loaded.
list.caption: Contract changes
